description: 'So what do you think about what's happening?' - asked in a kitchen, by someone with a position already formed, of a person whose cousin is not answering their phone.
energy_note: A debate, while you are waiting for a text.

description: Speak and be marked as political. Decline and be read as evasive or as endorsing something. There is no response that returns the conversation to the work you were doing.
energy_note: Three answers, all of them wrong.

aspect: It removes work as a refuge
description: The one place that was a functioning distraction becomes another site of it. People take leave they cannot afford, or go quiet in ways that damage their standing.
energy_note: Losing the only room it wasn't in.

aspect: And withdrawal is then held against you
description: The predictable response is retreat into the co-national community, which is then cited as a failure to integrate.
energy_note: Withdrawn for cause, and blamed for withdrawing.

aspect: EXAMPLE - deportation proposed before any charge
description: The Berlin Senate sought to deport four pro-Palestinian activists over an occupation at the Free University while investigations were still running. None had been charged or convicted. Three were EU nationals and one American; legal analysis held the expulsions probably unlawful.
energy_note: An expulsion order, ahead of the charge.
